children: Here’s a challenge. Using the five clues below, identify the company that is being talked about here.
1 I will soon complete 10 years of being listed, but have more than 30 years of business history, while my founders have a much longer legacy.

2 My chairman from my initial days retired recently and handed over to his son. He is one of the few Indians who can claim credentials from MIT, Stanford and Harvard, after a brief stint at IIT Bombay.
3 While my revenues crossed a billion dollars in recent years, I’ve had a market capitalisation of more than a billion dollars since listing.
4 Despite double-digit revenue and profit growth over the last 10 years, with return on equity consistently above 15 per cent, I haven’t provided any returns to shareholders.
5 A majority of my seven-member board of directors are women, including all my independent directors.

title: Who Am I? September 27, 2026
